name: Kubernetes & Container Platform Management
description: Operate EKS and other clusters: health, pods, workloads, nodes, logs, diagnosis and audited actions.

capabilities.name: Cluster lifecycle
capabilities.summary: Create (Launch → EKS), register existing EKS or kubeconfig clusters, connection test, control-plane details, delete through a reviewed Terraform destroy.

capabilities.name: Node pool management
capabilities.summary: Managed node groups with scaling, version and health; scale and upgrade (Terraform change for portal clusters, EKS API otherwise); cordon, uncordon and drain nodes.

capabilities.name: Autoscaling
capabilities.summary: Create HPAs (CPU and memory targets, scale-down stabilization), change min/max, delete; current vs target metrics with an at-max flag.

capabilities.name: Workload deployment
capabilities.summary: Deploy an app from an image (Deployment, Service, PDB, probes, non-root) or apply YAML, both with a server-side dry run and diff; restart, scale, change image, history and roll back, delete.

capabilities.name: Namespace management
capabilities.summary: Create namespaces with team label, Pod Security level, quota, default limits and default-deny network policy; list with pod counts; delete with typed confirmation.

capabilities.name: RBAC
capabilities.summary: Grant view/edit/admin in a namespace to a group, user or service account; list and remove role bindings; cluster-wide bindings read-only. Portal roles decide who may do what.

capabilities.name: Network policies
capabilities.summary: Default-deny, allow same namespace, allow from a namespace, allow a port; list, describe and delete.

capabilities.name: Ingress management
capabilities.summary: Create ingresses (AWS Load Balancer Controller annotations, ACM certificate, internal or internet-facing), list with addresses and TLS, describe, delete.

capabilities.name: Storage and PVC lifecycle
capabilities.summary: Create and delete PVCs, storage classes (default, type, expansion), persistent volumes and their claims.

capabilities.name: Resource quotas
capabilities.summary: Set quotas per namespace (CPU, memory, storage, object counts), view usage against limits, delete.

capabilities.name: Pod health
capabilities.summary: Pod status rules match kubectl, problem-pod list, diagnosis hints (OOMKilled, crash loop, image pull, config errors, readiness), logs with previous container, failed-pod cleanup.

capabilities.name: Scheduling analysis
capabilities.summary: Pending pods are explained from FailedScheduling events: insufficient CPU/memory, taints/affinity, unbound PVCs.

capabilities.name: Kubernetes upgrades
capabilities.summary: EKS upgrade insights, version skew, one-minor-step control-plane upgrade (Terraform change or EKS API), node group upgrade, add-on updates to the latest compatible version.
